postal_system.assignment_rule: La Poste Burkina Faso's live public reference search and the UPU Burkina Faso addressing sheet confirm five-digit codes. Commune, quartier and postal-agency assignments are distinct typed objects. Representative references include commune 10000 OUAGADOUGOU, quartier 10010 CISSIN and agency-style codes ending in non-zero digits. A postal-box number is not a postcode.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed source publishes a complete postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact or a rule that equates commune, quartier or agency assignments with an exact postal surface. Country, region, province, commune, quartier, village, office, Point, address, route, buffer, hull, raster/Voronoi cell and AGID geometry must remain independently typed.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Preserve recipient, premise, thoroughfare, sub-locality, special delivery or post-office reference, five-digit postcode, locality and country as separate fields in UPU line order.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Commune, quartier and agency results may share or subdivide code families; BP/BV/poste restante references and their numbers remain separate delivery objects.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an independently rights-cleared civic-address identity and explicit reviewed relation to point or footprint geometry.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: A live lookup result is reference evidence, not a reusable complete register. Derived postal geometry requires a documented, rights-compatible transformation from complete assignments and real source geometry; proximity, administrative fallback and interpolation are prohibited.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID identifies independent spatial cells and address context. A BF AGID ID is not a La Poste postcode or postal polygon.
postal_system.licence_rule: The reviewed La Poste site states all rights reserved and the UPU copyright page restricts reproduction and database use. No reviewed source grants compatible AGID processing, bulk extraction, storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights for the complete assignments or postal geometry.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO BF and Burkina Faso territory. Do not borrow assignments or geometry from another jurisdiction.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, box holders, customer addresses, parcel observations, precise coordinates, buildings and query logs remain excluded absent explicit authority and minimisation.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Live reference results are time-dependent; preserve retrieval time, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check after the pending-country sweep or an official release.

stages.definition: Burkina Faso address-format inventory, draft country pack, planning cells and conformance fixtures only.
Digest-bound La Poste, UPU and IGB reference evidence for the current five-digit system, typed commune/quartier/agency objects, address structure, rights boundary and no-proxy geometry contract.

M2 requires a current complete immutable La Poste Burkina Faso or competent public-authority denominator for every five-digit assignment, object type, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area status, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Every drawable code must reconcile to real Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry with postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, CRS, topology, reproducible method, confidence and exceptions. Commune, quartier, village, agency, BP/BV/poste restante, civic address, building, route, Point, buffer, hull, administrative boundary, Voronoi/raster cell, AGID cell and synthetic BF planning geometry are prohibited proxies unless an authoritative postal rule explicitly establishes the surface. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real BF API/app, handling normalization, loading, no-match, multiple candidates, API failure and invalid geometry, map fit, translucent fill, clear outline, clear/re-search, and visible code, geometry kind, class, source, date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: BF address metadata, source/rights research and draft planning fixtures only; no production BF Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: Complete rights-cleared assignments, real eligible postal geometry, immutable artifacts and actual BF API/app/browser verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Burkina Faso postal polygon. Independently licensed address context remains typed and source-qualified.
